questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All nodes are joints.

Some joints are bones.

All bones are cartilages.

**Conclusions:**

I. No node is a bone.

II. All joints are cartilages.

III. Some cartilages are nodes.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
From the given statements, the Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/120eba919b0329e11949f79943d628d3e715cc482b0ccb05d4b79cf62b4ee313.png] 

Now we consider the given conclusions:

**I. No node is a bone **→ Does not follow → As some joints are bones and all nodes are joints so there is a possibility that some nodes are bones and thus the conclusion does not follow.

**II. All joints are cartilages **→ Does not follow → As some joints are bones and all bones are cartilages so it can be said that some joints are cartilages but not all and therefore the conclusion does not follow.

**III. Some cartilages are nodes**→ Does not follow → As some cartilages with nodes and we cannot assume any relationship and from the figure we can see that no cartilages are nodes so the conclusion does not follow.

Since no conclusions follow.** **

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bells are trees.

Some trees are leaves.

All leaves are flowers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All bells are leaves.

II. Some flowers are trees.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
According to the given statements, we will get the Venn diagram as:

Thus, combining all the statements, we will get,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1b11156eb7e42bca1a94d1ddce663820edccbfdb305d88a2dc1035f8f0837e5c.png] 

Next, we will check all the conclusions as below:

I. All bells are leaves → Does not follow → As all bells are trees and some trees are leaves. So, some bells may or may not be leaves. This is not true.

II. Some flowers are trees → Follow → As some trees are leaves and all leaves are flowers. So, some flowers are leaves. Thus, some flowers are trees is true.

Thus, the **Only conclusion II** follows.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.

questions.question:
Select the correct option that indicates the arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order.

1. Country

2. Village

3. Taluka

4. State

5. District
questions.solution:
The arrangement of the following words in a logical and meaningful order will be:

2) The smallest one is called the **Village**.

3) Combining two or more villages is called **Taluka.**

5) Then many taluka are combined to form one **District**.

4) And again, many district come together to form a **State**.

1) Then many states together form a **Country**.

Thus, the order of words will be '**2, 3, 5, 4, 1**'.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 2**__'.
